_doc: Pricing constraints config for ENH-137 DynamicPricingEngine. Bank-overridable floors, ceilings, and per-category bounds. CBK-aware constraints (e.g. mortgage rate cap relative to CBR; deposit rate floor relative to inflation) — operators tune as regulation evolves.

SME Lending.rationale: Slightly higher SME risk premium permitted

Corporate.rationale: Corporate clients access lower spread; cap reflects negotiation room

Trade Finance.rationale: Trade finance typically priced as letter-of-credit fee + spread

Deposits.rationale: Deposit floor anchored to inflation; ceiling at COF + reasonable spread

Digital.rationale: Digital products use fee-based pricing not interest rate

Fee Income.rationale: Fee-based products use commission rates not interest

_notes: max_change_per_period_bps caps single-period pricing moves at 100bps to prevent customer-shock from pricing engines
min_margin_floor_pct ensures any pricing recommendation preserves at least 1% margin per ENH-131 fully-loaded margin computation
min_pricing_window_days enforces a 30-day stability window between pricing changes to allow market response observation
Banks tune category_constraints as CBK regulations evolve and as competitive pressure changes
